description.narrative: The proposed investment is a medium-term senior loan of up to US$15 million with ASA Microfinance Bank Limited, Pakistan (ASA MFB or the Bank). The senior loan proceeds will be fully utilized towards enhancing on-lending to women microfinance (WMF) borrowers and women-led/owned microenterprises (WMEs) across Pakistan (the Project). The Project will be processed under IFCs MSME Finance Platform (the Platform) which is supported by a pooled first loss guarantee of up to US$40 million provided by International Development Associations Private Sector Window Blended Finance Facility (IDA20-PSW BFF) allocated to the Base of the Pyramid (BOP) Envelope under the Platform.

This Project will enable ASA MFB to expand access to finance for WMF and WMEs in Pakistan. By supporting ASA MFB to further expand its loan portfolio in addition to potentially providing value-added services such as capacity building, the Project will demonstrate to the wider banking sector that the underserved segments of WMF borrowers and WMEs are an attractive asset class.
